aligned_role_words.interpretation: The previous u16le reads beginning at +87/+89 straddled the actual aligned big-endian words at +86/+88. The coarse nested-corpus role classification happened to remain unchanged, but the old field boundaries were invalid and have been replaced by aligned decoding.

code8.conclusion: The nested cavern/glass association is not a universal code-8 definition. Full-archive code 8 is also used for reflection/background/specular-related state.

code6.conclusion: Code 6 is a substantial full-archive state absent from the nested high-resolution relation-code-400 subset and must remain part of the projection/material frontier.

production_policy: Preserve +86/+88 aligned values and +24 raw. Nested high-resolution layer-role/mode correlations are useful but are explicitly subset-scoped. Modes 6/7/8 are not forced through the ordinary geometric UV generator; code 7 is strongly reflection-associated in the full outer archive, while code 8 has broader environment/specular usage than the nested glass example suggested.
